hint: Definite noun as subject — no separate article, the -en suffix is the article.
Most nouns add -er in the plural: maskin → maskiner.
Dør → dører (add -er).
Venn → venner (add -er).
Nouns ending in -e add only -r: klasse → klasser.
Regel → regler (irregular: unstressed -el drops the -e).
Short neuter nouns often have the same form in plural: ett år → tre år.
«Barn» is irregular — the plural is the same as the singular.
